name: camera
label: Camera
description: A camera's picture filling the card, new every few seconds or live; tap it to watch live for a while.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Which of its streams to show; its first, the largest, when left out.

live.title: Always live
live.description: Play it live all the time, not only when tapped.

label.title: Label
label.description: What to call it in place of its own name.

name: button
label: Button
description: One large button for a device's control: press it, switch it on and off, or set it to a value such as a mode or a scene.

value.title: Sets it to
value.description: What a press writes, such as on, eco or 21; the button is lit while the control is that. Left out, a press presses a button, and switches on and off to the other.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the button says in place of the control's name.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: A Tabler icon's name, such as bell, bulb or garage.

confirm.title: Ask first
confirm.description: A first press only asks for a second, for a door or a gate.
